NORTHAIRE COMFORT SYSTEMS CORPORATION
TERMS AND CONDITIONS OF SALE – EQUIPMENT AND/OR SERVICE

Rev. 08/21/26

Published at: https://www.northaire.com/terms-of-sale

---

1. PAYMENT AND TAXES

Payment shall be made net thirty (30) days from the date of invoice. Northaire reserves the right to require cash payment or other alternative payment method prior to shipment or completion of work if Northaire determines, in its sole discretion, that Customer or Customer's assignee's financial condition at any time does not justify continuance of the net 30-day payment term. In addition to the price, Customer shall pay Northaire any taxes or government charges arising from this Agreement. If Customer claims that any such taxes or government charges do not apply to the transactions governed by this Agreement, Customer shall provide Northaire with acceptable tax exemption certificates or other applicable documents. All past due invoices will accrue interest at the lesser of one percent (1%) per month or the maximum interest rate allowable under law.

2. EXTRAS

Equipment, parts, or labor in addition to those specified in this Agreement will be provided upon receipt of Customer's written authorization, paid for as an extra at Northaire's prevailing labor rates and equipment/parts charges, and subject to the terms of this Agreement.

3. RETURNS

No items will be accepted for return without prior written authorization. Returned goods may be subject to a restocking charge. Special order and non-stock items cannot be returned.

4. SHIPMENT

All shipments shall be EXW shipping point. Northaire's loading dock shall be the shipping point. Customer is responsible for all freight charges, customs clearance, and risks involved in the shipment to the job site. Shipment dates quoted are approximate. Northaire does not guarantee a particular date for shipment or delivery.

5. PARTIAL SHIPMENT

Northaire shall have the right to ship any portion of the equipment, goods, or other materials included in this Agreement and invoice Customer for such partial shipment.

6. DELAYS

Northaire shall not be liable for delays in manufacturing, shipping, or delivery by causes beyond the control and without the fault or negligence of Northaire, including but not limited to acts of God, acts of a public enemy, acts of government, acts of terrorism, fires, floods, epidemics, quarantine restrictions, freight embargoes, supplier delays, strikes, or labor difficulties (collectively "Force Majeure Events") which directly or indirectly affect manufacturing, shipping, or delivery. Northaire shall remain excused from performance to the extent which, in its reasonable discretion, any such Force Majeure Event(s) continue to negatively impact Northaire's performance, whether or not the Force Majeure Event itself has ended. Northaire agrees to notify Customer in writing as soon as practicable of the causes of such delay. In the event that any materials or equipment to be provided by Northaire under this Agreement become permanently unavailable as a result of a Force Majeure Event, Northaire shall be excused from furnishing such materials or equipment.

7. WARRANTY

Northaire warrants that all equipment manufactured by Northaire Corporation and all Northaire equipment, parts or components supplied hereunder will be free from defects in material and workmanship. Northaire shall at its option repair or replace, EXW point of sale, any equipment, part, or component sold by Northaire and determined to be defective within one (1) year from the date of initial operation or eighteen (18) months from date of shipment, whichever is earlier. Northaire does not warrant products not manufactured by Northaire Corporation, but it does pass on to Customer any transferable manufacturer warranties for those products. Northaire warrants that all physical service performed by Northaire hereunder shall be performed in a workmanlike manner. In the event any such service is determined to be defective within ninety (90) days of completion of that service, Northaire shall at its option re-perform or issue a credit for such service. Northaire's obligation to repair or replace any defective equipment, parts or components during the warranty period shall be Customer's exclusive remedy. Northaire shall not be responsible for labor charges for removal or reinstallation of defective equipment, parts, or components, for charges for transportation, handling and shipping or refrigerant loss, or for repairs or replacement of such equipment, parts, or components, required as a consequence of faulty installation, misapplication, vandalism, abuse, exposure to chemicals, improper servicing, unauthorized alteration, or improper operation by persons other than Northaire. For clarity, any diagnostics, analytics, monitoring outputs, telemetry-based insights, reports, or advisory information provided through Northaire Technology or any digital platform are informational only and are not warranted to identify all faults, prevent failures, eliminate downtime, or achieve any particular operational, energy, or performance outcome. THIS WARRANTY IS GIVEN IN LIEU OF ALL OTHER WARRANTIES, EXPRESS, IMPLIED OR STATUTORY INCLUDING THE IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE. CUSTOMER ACKNOWLEDGES THAT NORTHAIRE MAKES NO REPRESENTATION OR WARRANTY THAT THE IRON, STEEL, MANUFACTURED PRODUCTS AND/OR CONSTRUCTION MATERIALS USED BY NORTHAIRE IN CONNECTION WITH MEETING ITS OBLIGATIONS UNDER THE WARRANTY WITH RESPECT TO REPAIR OR REPLACEMENT WILL COMPLY WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF THE INFRASTRUCTURE INVESTMENT AND JOBS ACT, THE BUY AMERICAN ACT OR ANY SIMILAR LAWS OR REGULATIONS. Should Northaire announce a product modification program (or product recall or any similar type of action), Customer will use reasonable efforts to cause such program or action to be carried out with respect to all equipment and/or services purchased, installed and/or in use by Customer, and to cause the program's intended result to be accomplished as rapidly and as thoroughly and as completely as practicable.

8. WORKING HOURS

All services performed under this Agreement, including but not limited to, major repairs, are to be provided during Northaire's normal working hours unless otherwise agreed.

9. CUSTOMER RESPONSIBILITIES (Service Contracts only)

Customer shall:

• Provide safe and reasonable equipment access and a safe work environment.
• Permit access to Customer's site, and use of building services including but not limited to water, elevators, receiving dock facilities, electrical service and local telephone service.
• Keep areas adjacent to equipment free of extraneous material, move any stock, fixtures, walls, or partitions that may be necessary to perform the specified service.
• Promptly notify Northaire of any unusual operating conditions.
• Upon agreement of a timely mutual schedule, allow Northaire to stop and start equipment necessary to perform service.
• Provide adequate water treatment.
• Provide the daily routine equipment operation (if not part of this Agreement) including availability of routine equipment log readings.
• Where Northaire's remote monitoring service is provided, provide, and maintain all relevant communications equipment and service, which may include, but not be limited to a telephone line with long distance direct dial and answer capability, internet access or Wi-Fi.
• Operate the equipment properly and in accordance with Northaire instructions.
• Promptly address any issues that arise related to mold, fungi, mildew, or bacteria.
• Properly safeguard the work area from the public.
• Identify and label any asbestos containing material that may be present. The customer will provide, in writing, prior to the start of a job, a signed statement regarding the absence or presence of asbestos for any job where the building or the equipment to be serviced is older than 1981. Should this document state that no asbestos is present, the customer will also provide in writing the method used to determine the absence of asbestos.

Customer acknowledges that, notwithstanding the availability of Telemetry Data, analytics, or monitoring visibility, Customer retains sole responsibility for equipment operation, safety, regulatory compliance, and all decisions regarding response, repair, or corrective action. Northaire does not assume operational responsibility by virtue of data visibility or analytics.

10. EXCLUSIONS

Northaire is not responsible for items not normally subject to mechanical maintenance including but not limited to: duct work, casings, cabinets, fixtures, structural supports, grillage, water piping, steam piping, drain piping, cooling tower fill, boiler tubes, boiler refractory, disconnect switches and circuit breakers. Northaire is not responsible for repairs, replacements, alterations, additions, adjustments, repairs by others, unscheduled or emergency calls, or conditions necessitated by negligent operation, abuse, misuse, prior improper maintenance, vandalism, obsolescence, building system design, damage due to weather conditions, chemical/electrochemical attack, corrosion, erosion, deterioration due to unusual wear and tear, mold, fungi, mildew, bacteria, power reductions or failures or any cause beyond Northaire's reasonable control. Northaire shall not be required to perform tests, install equipment, or make modifications recommended or required by insurance companies or governmental authorities. Any such work, if performed, shall be subject to a separate written agreement. Without limiting the foregoing, Northaire shall not be responsible for decisions, actions, or outcomes based on Telemetry Data, analytics, reports, dashboards, alerts, or advisory outputs, including any interpretation or reliance thereon by Customer or third parties. Northaire shall not be required to repair or replace equipment that has not been properly maintained. Northaire shall not be responsible under this agreement for repairs to any equipment that has exceeded its normal service life per ASHRAE published guidelines.

11. EQUIPMENT CONDITION & RECOMMENDED SERVICE (Service Contracts only)

Upon the initial scheduled operating and/or initial annual stop inspection, should Northaire determine the need for repairs or replacement, Northaire will provide Customer in writing an 'equipment condition' report including recommendations for corrections and the price for repairs in addition to this Agreement. In the event Northaire recommends certain services (that are not included herein or upon initial inspection) and if Customer does not elect to have such services properly performed in a timely fashion, Northaire shall not be responsible for any equipment or control failures, operability or any long-term damage that may result. Northaire at its option will either continue to maintain equipment and/or controls to the best of its ability, without any responsibility, or remove such equipment from this Agreement, adjusting the price accordingly.

12. PROPRIETARY RIGHTS

During the term of this Agreement and in connection with certain equipment sales and/or services, Northaire may elect to install, attach to Customer equipment, or provide portable, embedded or remote devices, controllers, gateways, software, firmware or other digital components (collectively, "Northaire Technology"). All Northaire Technology shall remain the sole and exclusive personal and proprietary property of Northaire or its licensors. No Northaire Technology installed, attached to real property or provided to Customer shall become a fixture of the Customer premises, and Customer shall not acquire any interest, title or equity in any Northaire Technology, including any associated software, firmware, configuration files, processes, analytics, models, algorithms, or other intellectual property. Whether or not Customer has entered into a Northaire service agreement, and including with respect to controllers, connectivity hardware, and other control systems ("Controls"), Northaire may, in its discretion, install, deploy, modify, update, patch, configure, or replace Northaire Technology, including software, firmware, security components, features, or settings by remote or over-the-air means, as Northaire deems reasonably necessary or appropriate to support service delivery, cybersecurity, regulatory compliance, system reliability, compatibility, or performance. Without limiting the foregoing, and even in the absence of any service agreement, Northaire may deliver over-the-air security patches, firmware updates, and critical or regulatory-compliance updates to Controls and other Northaire Technology where Northaire reasonably determines such updates are necessary to address a security vulnerability, safety issue, or legal or regulatory requirement. Such updates may be implemented with or without on-site intervention and may result in temporary interruption of controller communications or functionality. Northaire will use commercially reasonable efforts to provide advance notice of material updates that are reasonably expected to materially affect the functionality of Controls, except that Northaire may deploy security, safety, or regulatory updates without advance notice where Northaire determines that delay could increase risk; notice, where given, may be provided by email, service portal, product notification, or other reasonable means. Customer acknowledges and agrees that: (a) such updates do not constitute physical modifications to the equipment; (b) such updates do not expand, modify, or create any service obligations, response commitments, performance guarantees, or warranties beyond those expressly stated in this Agreement or any applicable written service agreement; and (c) Northaire does not warrant or guarantee that any Northaire Technology, update, monitoring capability, or analytic output will prevent failures, eliminate downtime, achieve any particular operational, energy, or performance outcome, or ensure regulatory compliance. Customer shall not disable, block, or interfere with the delivery or installation of security, safety, or regulatory updates to Controls or other Northaire Technology, and Customer is solely responsible for any consequences of doing so. Northaire Technology, including any monitoring, diagnostics, analytics, alerts, reports, or insights derived therefrom, is provided solely to support Northaire's service delivery and/or Customer's informational use. Northaire Technology does not operate, control, supervise, or manage Customer equipment and does not create any obligation for continuous monitoring, fault detection, dispatch, response, or intervention unless expressly stated in a separate written service agreement. All Northaire Technology, including any updates, enhancements, or modifications, shall remain the proprietary property of Northaire or its licensors. Customer shall not, and shall not permit any third party to, extract, decompile, disassemble, reverse engineer, or otherwise attempt to derive the source code, underlying structure, or algorithms of any Northaire Technology or related software or firmware.

12A. EMBEDDED SOFTWARE LICENSE; OPEN SOURCE; SECURITY

(a) Embedded Software License. To the extent any equipment sold under this Agreement contains embedded firmware or software ("Embedded Software") that is necessary for the intended operation of such equipment, Northaire grants Customer a limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable, royalty-free license to use the Embedded Software solely as embedded in, and for the operation of, the equipment on which it is installed, for so long as Customer owns or lawfully possesses such equipment. This license does not extend to any standalone software product licensed under a separate end user license agreement (including without limitation the i-Vu® On-Premises EULA referenced in Section 41), which shall govern exclusively as to such standalone products. Customer shall not extract, copy, modify, or transfer the Embedded Software separately from the equipment in which it is installed, except as expressly permitted by Northaire in writing.

(b) Open Source Software. The Embedded Software may include open source or third-party software components that are licensed to Northaire under separate license terms ("Open Source Components"). Open Source Components are provided subject to the applicable open source license terms. To the extent of any conflict between this Agreement and the applicable open source license terms with respect to an Open Source Component, the applicable open source license terms shall control solely as to that component. Nothing in this Agreement shall be construed to limit any rights granted to Customer under an applicable open source license or to impose greater restrictions on any Open Source Component than are permitted under its applicable license.

(c) Security Updates and Product Lifecycle. Northaire may, in accordance with Section 12, provide security patches, firmware updates, and other updates to the Embedded Software during the commercially supported lifecycle of the applicable equipment. Northaire does not guarantee that security updates will be available for any particular period, and Northaire may designate equipment or Embedded Software as end-of-life or end-of-support, following which no further updates, including security updates, will be provided. Customer is responsible for maintaining reasonable network security measures (including segmentation and access controls) for any equipment connected to Customer's networks, and for promptly installing or authorizing installation of security updates made available by Northaire. Northaire maintains a vulnerability disclosure and reporting process, information regarding which is available upon request or at Northaire's published security policy, if any.

(d) Software Warranty Carve-Out. The Embedded Software and any Open Source Components are provided "AS IS" apart from the limited hardware warranty described in Section 7, which applies to the equipment as a whole. Northaire does not separately warrant that the Embedded Software will be error-free, uninterrupted, or free from vulnerabilities, and Section 7's disclaimers with respect to diagnostics, analytics, and advisory outputs apply equally to any such functionality provided by the Embedded Software.

13. DATA RIGHTS (Service Contracts only)

Customer hereby grants and agrees to grant to Northaire a worldwide, non-exclusive, non-terminable, irrevocable, perpetual, paid-up, royalty free license, with the right to sublicense to its affiliates and suppliers, to any Source Data and Telemetry Data for the following purposes: (i) Northaire's performance of services pursuant to this Agreement, (ii) the improvement of Northaire services and analytics platform; (iii) improving product performance, operation, reliability, and maintainability; (iv) creation and use of aggregated, anonymized, or de-identified datasets and statistics for benchmarking, development of best practices, and product improvement; (v) the provision and enhancement of Northaire offerings; and (vi) research, statistical, and marketing purposes, and/or in support of Northaire agreements. For purposes of this Agreement: "Telemetry Data" means machine-generated, sensor-based, controller, or equipment operating data transmitted from Customer equipment or systems, including data related to status, performance, alarms, or operating conditions. Source Data means data produced directly from a system or device and received at a collection point or central server (including Northaire databases, data lakes, or third-party cloud services) and includes Telemetry Data. Customer acknowledges and agrees that the collection, transmission, processing, or analysis of Telemetry Data and Source Data is informational and advisory in nature and does not constitute operation, control, supervision, or management of Customer equipment, nor does it create any obligation for continuous monitoring, fault detection, dispatch, response, or performance outcomes unless expressly stated in a separate written service agreement.

14. DATA RETENTION AND USE (Service Contracts only)

Customer acknowledges and agrees that Northaire Technology may collect, transmit, and process Telemetry Data and Source Data in connection with the performance of services under this Agreement. Such data may be stored, processed, and used by Northaire and its affiliates in accordance with Section 13 of this Agreement. Telemetry Data and Source Data transmitted to or processed by Northaire may be retained by Northaire in aggregated, anonymized, de-identified, or transformed form as part of Northaire's databases, analytics platforms, historical records, and service improvement processes. Northaire has no obligation to return, provide, export, or make available raw Telemetry Data or Source Data to Customer, except as expressly agreed in writing or required under an applicable Data Processing Agreement with respect to Personal Data. For clarity, upon termination or expiration of this Agreement: (a) Northaire shall have no obligation to delete or return Telemetry Data or Source Data that has been incorporated into Northaire systems, analytics, or aggregated datasets; (b) Northaire may retain and continue to use such data as permitted under Section 13; and (c) the handling, return, or deletion of Personal Data shall be governed exclusively by the applicable Data Processing Agreement.

15. DATA TRANSMISSION AND CUSTOMER RESPONSIBILITIES

During the term of this Agreement, Customer shall use commercially reasonable efforts to: (a) ensure that Northaire-provided hardware or devices, if any, remain powered and connected as reasonably required to support the services; (b) avoid intentional actions that materially impede or block the collection and transmission of Telemetry Data or Source Data by Northaire; and (c) refrain from intentionally disabling, removing, or tampering with Northaire Technology without Northaire's prior written consent, which shall not be unreasonably withheld. Customer acknowledges and agrees that the transmission of Telemetry Data and Source Data is intended solely to support Northaire's services and analytics and is informational and advisory in nature. The availability, completeness, or continuity of such data does not create any obligation for Northaire to monitor equipment continuously, detect faults, generate alerts, dispatch personnel, or take corrective action unless expressly stated in a separate written service agreement. Northaire shall not be responsible for interruptions, gaps, inaccuracies, or failures in data transmission caused by Customer systems, site conditions, third-party networks, power outages, or factors outside Northaire's reasonable control.

16. REVERSE ENGINEERING

Customer shall not, and shall not permit any third party to, extract, decompile, disassemble, reverse engineer, or otherwise attempt to derive the source code, underlying structure, logic, models, algorithms, or design of any Northaire Technology, software, firmware, analytics, reports, dashboards, or digital outputs provided or made available in connection with this Agreement. Customer shall not use Telemetry Data, Source Data, analytics outputs, or reports provided hereunder to develop, benchmark, validate, or support competing products or services, or to attempt to replicate Northaire's methodologies, models, or intellectual property. Nothing in this Agreement shall be construed to grant Customer any rights to Northaire Technology or digital outputs except as expressly stated herein.

17. WAIVER OF DAMAGES

Under no circumstances shall Northaire be liable for any indirect, incidental, collateral, special, punitive, or consequential damages, including but not limited to loss of revenue or profit, recalls, loss of use of equipment or facilities, loss of data, or economic damages howsoever arising.

18. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY

Northaire's maximum liability for any reason (except for personal injuries) arising from this Agreement shall not exceed the value of the payments received by Northaire under this Agreement.

19. CANCELLATION

Customer may cancel this Agreement only with Northaire's prior written consent, and upon payment of reasonable cancellation charges. Such charges shall take into account costs and expenses incurred, and purchases or contract commitments made by Northaire and all other losses due to the cancellation including a reasonable profit.

20. CUSTOMER TERMINATION FOR NORTHAIRE NON-PERFORMANCE

Customer shall have the right to terminate this Agreement for Northaire's non-performance provided Northaire fails to cure such non-performance within thirty (30) days after having been given prior written notice of the non-performance. Upon early termination or expiration of this Agreement, Northaire shall have free access to enter Customer locations to disconnect and remove any Northaire personal proprietary property or devices as well as remove any and all Northaire-owned parts, tools, and personal property. Additionally, Customer agrees to pay Northaire for all incurred but unamortized service costs performed by Northaire including overheads and a reasonable profit.

21. NORTHAIRE TERMINATION

Northaire reserves the right to discontinue its service any time payments have not been made as agreed or if alterations, additions, or repairs are made to equipment during the term of this Agreement by others without prior agreement between Customer and Northaire.

22. CLAIMS

Any lawsuits arising from the performance or nonperformance of this Agreement, with the exception of any claims for non-payment, whether based upon contract, negligence, strict liability or otherwise, shall be brought within one (1) year from the date the claim arose. In the event of any dispute arising out of or related in any way to this Agreement, Northaire shall be entitled to recover all costs and expenses incurred in enforcing its rights hereunder, whether based in contract, tort or otherwise, including but not limited to all costs and attorney's fees incurred in any such dispute.

23. GOVERNMENT PROCUREMENTS

The components, equipment and services provided by Northaire are commercial products and commercial services as defined in Section 2.101 of the Federal Acquisition Regulations ("FAR"), and the prices of such components, equipment and services are based on Northaire's commercial pricing policies and practices (which do not consider any special requirements of U.S. Government cost principles, FAR Part 31, or any similar procurement regulations). As such, Northaire will not agree to provide or certify cost or pricing data, nor will Northaire agree to comply with the Cost Accounting Standards (CAS). In addition, no federal government procurement regulations, such as FARs or DFARs, shall apply to this Agreement except those regulations expressly accepted in writing by Northaire.

24. INTERNATIONAL TRADE COMPLIANCE

Sales and distribution of commodities, materials, hardware, software, services, and technology Customer receives from Northaire pursuant to this Agreement (the "Product") may constitute an export, reexport, or transfer, and such transactions must be conducted in accordance with the export control, trade, and economic sanctions laws and regulations of the government authorities with jurisdiction over such activities, including the European Union and its Member States, the United States, and the United Kingdom (collectively, "Trade Control Laws").

a. Customer will conduct all activities under this Agreement in compliance with Trade Control Laws.

b. Customer will not sell, supply, export, reexport, or transfer Products directly or indirectly to: 1. Belarus, Cuba, Iran, North Korea, Russia, Syria, or the Crimea, Donetsk, Kherson, Luhansk, or Zaporizhzhia regions of Ukraine or any other region that becomes restricted (each a "Restricted Country"); 2. to an individual or entity that is (i) an individual or entity designated on the U.S. Department of the Treasury's Office of Foreign Assets Control's ("OFAC") Specially Designated Nationals ("SDNs") and Blocked Persons List, the U.S. Department of Commerce's Bureau of Industry and Security's Entity List, the European Union's Consolidated List of Sanctions, as well as those of applicable Member States, and the UK Consolidated List; (ii) the Government of a Restricted Country, Venezuela, or Afghanistan, (iii) a person ordinarily resident in, or an entity registered under the laws of, a Restricted Country, (iv) an entity owned or controlled by a party in (i)-(iii), or (v) a person acting on behalf of, or for the benefit of, a party in (i)-(iv) (Parties in subparagraph 2(i)-(v) collectively, a "Denied Party"); 3. for an unauthorized end-use; or 4. in violation of Trade Control Laws.

c. Customer shall conduct reasonable diligence to verify its customers' or end-users' identity and location and confirm the Products' intended end-use (collectively, "End-User Diligence"). Customer's End-User Diligence must be sufficient to identify and prevent unauthorized transactions, including those involving Restricted Countries and Denied Parties. Customer shall promptly notify Northaire of any transactions involving Restricted Countries and Denied Parties, or other violations of Trade Control Laws with respect to Products or related services.

d. Notwithstanding any other provision of this contract, Northaire will not provide warranty, repair, replacement, or guarantee services for Products in Restricted Countries, to Denied Parties, or in violation of Trade Control Laws. If Customer extends to its clients any warranty that is broader in scope than the limited warranty provided by Northaire, Customer shall be solely responsible for all costs, expenses, liabilities, obligations, and damages resulting from the extension of such warranty.

e. Upon request, Customer shall promptly provide Northaire with information about Customer's export of Products, including, without limitation, description, volume, value, Customer and/or end-user, transaction dates, and service details.

f. Customer represents and warrants that neither it nor its respective directors, officers, employees, or affiliates is a Denied Party or is located, organized, or resident in a Restricted Country.

g. Northaire can terminate this Agreement effective immediately upon any of the following: 1. Customer becomes a Denied Party; 2. Customer violates Trade Controls or this clause with respect to any of the activities subject to this Agreement; or 3. Northaire reasonably determines that its Trade Control Laws compliance obligations prohibit Northaire's performance (each a "Trade Controls Event"). Termination under this clause shall be deemed a termination for just cause, relieving Northaire of any obligation to make further sales or provide further services (including warranty, repair, replacement, or guarantee services) under this Agreement, or to deliver any Products to Customer.

h. Customer shall hold Northaire harmless against all liabilities, and, to the extent permitted by Trade Control Laws, indemnify Northaire for all costs, expenses, damages, and losses incurred by Northaire arising from a Trade Controls Event or violation of this section. In no event shall Northaire be liable for any special, incidental, exemplary, or consequential damages, including but not limited to, lost profits, fines, or penalties imposed on Customer by relevant governmental authorities, arising in connection with Northaire's performance under this Agreement, including but not limited to delays, fees, or limitations imposed in connection with Trade Control Laws.

25. HAZARDOUS MATERIALS

The Customer is solely responsible for the identification, detection, abatement, encapsulating or removal of asbestos, goods or materials containing asbestos, similar hazardous substances, or mold, fungi, mildew, or bacteria at a Customer site. If Northaire encounters any asbestos or other hazardous material while performing this Agreement, Northaire may immediately suspend its work and remove its employees from the project, until such material and any hazards associated with it are abated to Northaire's satisfaction. The time for Northaire's performance shall be extended accordingly, and Northaire shall be compensated for the delay.

26. WASTE DISPOSAL

Customer is wholly responsible for the removal and proper disposal of waste oil, refrigerant and any other material generated during the term of this Agreement.

27. SUPERSEDURE, ASSIGNMENT and MODIFICATION

This Agreement, together with any written proposals, order documents, and referenced attachments expressly incorporated herein, constitutes the complete and exclusive statement of the agreement between Northaire and Customer with respect to the subject matter hereof and supersedes all previous or contemporaneous, oral or written agreements, representations, or understanding. Customer may not assign, transfer, or delegate this Agreement, in whole or in part, without Northaire's prior written consent, which consent shall not be unreasonably withheld. Northaire may assign, transfer or delegate this Agreement, in whole or in part, upon written notice to Customer, including, without limitation, to an affiliate, in connection with a corporate reorganization, merger, sale of assets, or to facilitate performance through authorized service providers, subcontractors, suppliers, or digital platforms. Any permitted assignee shall assume the assigning party's obligations hereunder. Northaire may perform its obligations under this Agreement through its affiliates, authorized service providers, subcontractors, suppliers, or digital platforms, provided that Northaire remains responsible for such performance in accordance with this Agreement. No amendment, modification, or waiver of this Agreement shall be binding unless in writing and signed by authorized representatives of both parties. Orders shall be binding upon Northaire only when accepted in writing by an authorized representative of Northaire. NORTHAIRE'S ACCEPTANCE OF ANY CUSTOMER'S PURCHASE ORDER OR SIMILAR DOCUMENT IS EXPRESSLY CONDITIONED UPON CUSTOMER'S ACCEPTANCE OF THE TERMS AND CONDITIONS SET FORTH HEREIN AND ANY ADDITIONAL OR CONFLICTING TERMS OR CONDITIONS PROPOSED BY CUSTOMER, WHETHER CONTAINED IN A PURCHASE ORDER OR OTHERWISE, ARE HEREBY REJECTED AND SHALL HAVE NO FORCE OR EFFECT. THE FAILURE OF NORTHAIRE AT ANY TIME TO ENFORCE ANY PROVISION IN THIS AGREEMENT SHALL NOT BE CONSTRUED AS A WAIVER OF SUCH PROVISION OR OF NORTHAIRE'S RIGHT THEREAFTER TO ENFORCE EACH AND EVERY PROVISION OF THIS AGREEMENT.

28. CUSTOMER CONSENT

Customer grants to Northaire and its successors and/or assigns the right to photograph Customer's premises where the equipment and/or services were installed or performed. Customer further grants to Northaire and its successors and/or assigns the right to use those photographs and videos, Customer's name and nature of Customer's relationship with Northaire in all forms of media for Northaire's marketing campaigns including but not limited to press releases, case studies, project profiles, newsletters, social media and promotional brochures.

29. CALIFORNIA SPECIFIC PROVISIONS

a. FOR WORK BEING PERFORMED IN CALIFORNIA

Contractors are required by law to be licensed and regulated by the Contractors' State License Board which has jurisdiction to investigate complaints against contractors if a complaint regarding a latent act or omission is filed within four (4) years of the date of the alleged violation. A complaint regarding a latent act or omission pertaining to structural defects must be filed within ten (10) years of the date of the alleged violation. Any questions concerning a contractor may be referred to the Registrar, Contractors' State License Board, P.O. Box 26000, Sacramento, California 95826.

b. FOR CONTRACTS AWARDED BY THE STATE OF CALIFORNIA

During the performance of this contract, contractor and its subcontractors shall not unlawfully discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, reproductive health decision making, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, or military and veteran status. Contractors and subcontractors shall insure that the evaluation and treatment of their employees and applicants for employment are free of such discrimination. Contractors and subcontractors shall comply with the provisions of the Fair Employment and Housing Act (Gov. Code, § 12900 et seq.) and the applicable regulations promulgated thereunder (Cal. Code Regs., tit. 2, § 11000 et seq.). The applicable regulations of the Civil Rights Council implementing Government Code section 12990, set forth in Subchapter 5 of Division 4.1 of Title 2 of the California Code of Regulations are incorporated into this contract by reference and made a part hereof as if set forth in full. Contractor and its subcontractors shall give written notice of their obligations under this clause to labor organizations with which they have a collective bargaining or other agreement.

30. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY

Notwithstanding anything to the contrary stated herein, Northaire and its licensors retain all right, title, and interest in and to all intellectual property, including without limitation all Northaire Technology, software, firmware, analytics, models, algorithms, reports, dashboards, documentation, data structure, methodologies, processes, and other materials provided or made available in connection with this Agreement. Subject to Customer's compliance with this Agreement, Northaire grants Customer a limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable, non-sublicensable license to use any reports, dashboards, analytics outputs, or other deliverables provided hereunder solely for Customer's internal business purposes during the term of this Agreement. No other license or rights are granted by implication, estoppel, or otherwise. Customer shall not copy, modify, distribute, publish, sublicense, sell, lease, or otherwise exploit any Northaire intellectual property or deliverables, except as expressly permitted in this Agreement or a separate written agreement executed by the parties. For clarity, Telemetry Data, Source Data, analytics outputs, and other informational or advisory materials do not convey to Customer any ownership interest in Northaire intellectual property and do not grant Customer any rights to Northaire's underlying software, firmware, models, algorithms, or methodologies.

31. DATA PRIVACY

To the extent Northaire processes Personal Data (as defined in the applicable Data Processing Agreement) in connection with the performance of this Agreement, such processing shall be governed exclusively by the Data Processing Agreement entered into between Customer and Northaire (or the applicable Northaire affiliate) (the "DPA"), which is incorporated herein by reference. Each party shall comply with its respective obligations under applicable data protection and privacy laws, including, where applicable, the California Consumer Privacy Act and its implementing regulations, as amended, and other applicable US state privacy laws. Except as expressly set forth in the DPA, nothing in this Agreement shall be interpreted to modify, expand, or limit either party's rights or obligations with respect to the processing of Personal Data.
